description: Find possible freezes in a selected 1–120 second video range or a caller-selected fixed region. For longer videos the default is the first 120 seconds; pass fromSeconds and durationSeconds to inspect another section. Timestamps refer to the original video. Flags require human review. A fixed rectangle does not track objects; camera movement and intentional stills confound results. Does not certify natural motion.
name: check_full_frame_freeze
title: Find possible frozen video frames or a still region
